s: Abu Dhabi (an emirate of the United Arab Emirates, on the southern Persian Gulf)
Abu Dhabi (the capital city of the United Arab Emirates)
Abu Dhabi.et: From Arabic أَبُو ظَبْي (ʔabū ẓaby), probably in part through English Abu Dhabi, as the transliteration dh for Arabic ظ (ẓ) is not common in German.

ab und zu.et: Literally, “off and to”. Compare Dutch af en toe.

s: The condition abulia, absence of will-power or decisiveness
Abulie.et: From New Latin abūlia, from Ancient Greek ἀβουλῐ́ᾱ (aboulĭ́ā, “ill-advisedness, thoughtlessness”).

l: An der Abundant Life Christian School, einer christlichen Privatschule, werden etwa 420 Schülerinnen und Schüler verschiedener Altersgruppen unterrichtet.
